description: This header file defines interfaces for the engine controller module, including function prototypes for initialization, voltage mocking, state printing, and a utility to get pin names by ADC channel. It also includes relevant include directives and macro guards.

methods.name: getPinNameByAdcChannel
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a pin associated with a given ADC channel, with a message and buffer for output.

methods.name: initPeriodicEvents
methods.description: Initializes periodic engine-related events, using provided engine parameters.

methods.name: initEngineContoller
methods.description: Initializes the engine controller with shared logging and engine parameters.

methods.name: commonInitEngineController
methods.description: Performs common initialization routines for the engine controller.

methods.name: setMockVBattVoltage
methods.description: Mocks the battery voltage for testing purposes.

methods.name: setMockMapVoltage
methods.description: Mocks the manifold absolute pressure sensor voltage.

methods.name: setMockTpsVoltage
methods.description: Mocks the throttle position sensor voltage.

methods.name: setMockAfrVoltage
methods.description: Mocks the air-fuel ratio sensor voltage.

methods.name: setMockMafVoltage
methods.description: Mocks the mass air flow sensor voltage.

methods.name: setMockIatVoltage
methods.description: Mocks the intake air temperature sensor voltage.

methods.name: setMockCltVoltage
methods.description: Mocks the coolant temperature sensor voltage.

methods.name: printCurrentState
methods.description: Prints the current engine state to logs, including a duration in seconds and a name identifier.
